svg.title: 34 repositories in orbit
svg.desc: A rotating 3D sphere with one point for each of 34 public repositories, colored by section. Original projects: 2; DeFi & on-chain tooling: 3; AI agents & memory: 13; Browser automation & scraping: 6; Local inference & self-hosted: 7; Gaming & experiments: 3.
svg.text: 2 original + 32 open-source forks, colored by section.
